purpose: E normal-condition evidence, E-to-U transfer and U-fit recovery in existing checkpoints; not a causal participation proof or original CDI reference-set test
patient_label: Actual patient participation in each target: model_1 A positive/model_2 B positive, independently cross-checked with exposure metadata
E_image_label: For member patients only, the designated E train-candidate images have actual exposure>0; nonmember E images were not trained
U_image_label: All queried U images have zero actual exposure even for member patients

logistic_regression.tuning: minimum arithmetic mean of five validation patient log_losses; exact tie lower C
logistic_regression.per_image_fit_label: patient membership from actual incremental exposure; E image membership equals patient membership, U image membership is always zero

bootstrap.strata: selection assignment A and B; sample 20 within each with replacement; concatenate A then B; same indices for all methods and both targets
bootstrap.auc: member-positive ROC AUC with half credit for ties
bootstrap.conditional_on: fixed fitted attack models, frozen target checkpoints and this previously opened selection cohort; fitting uncertainty not resampled

fitting_policy.E: Reuse hash-pinned original fit_family and predict_patients; fit20 new LR scorers on E-fit80 only with unchanged5fold/logloss/C policy
fitting_policy.U: Restore exact saved20 U scalers/LRs/C and verify original U predictions; no U refit or retune
fitting_policy.scalar: Eight fixed scalar methods need no fitting; E/U fit-scenario copies must be identical at a fixed evaluation scenario

execution_policy: Freeze this analysis contract before E GPU; actual analyzer/source and complete E inputs hash-bound in new protocol before fitting; require E and U raw verification PASS first
scope_limits: selection40 is repeatedly used development data, not independent confirmation or a held-out final test
Target checkpoints, patients, images, methods, directions and hyperparameter grid are fixed; no selection-based winner or threshold selection
All E-fit tuning uses only E fit80 patient folds; U evaluation must not select E scorer C or scaler
U-fitted scorers retain existing U-fit80 auxiliary labels; comparison is not patient-only access
Two target checkpoints have complementary membership and shared cohorts; they are dependent, not independent replicates
Paired bootstrap is conditional on fixed scorers and targets and does not include scorer fitting uncertainty; intervals are exploratory and not multiplicity-adjusted
E success is useful normal-condition evidence, not a logical prerequisite for U signal; weak E cannot establish impossible U
Transfer loss can reflect image/domain shift or scorer mismatch; U-fit recovery alone is not a causal participation proof
NO27 remains an explicitly labelled source-quirk diagnostic, not a new feature chosen from results
DINO E embeddings/scores are absent; do not substitute U DINO for E. Preserve original U DINO result outside these18-method cells
No base/other-target score, paired delta, R feature or patient identity input is added to attack features
No new target training, GPU calls, original CDI reference-set test, low-FPR calibration or overall stage2 success gate in this analysis
